scale_notes.1: The executable is loaded and its code starts running.
scale_notes.2: Gets through the game's own startup (runtime, memory, threads, files).
scale_notes.3: Creates its graphics device and starts talking to the GPU.
scale_notes.4: Submits or presents frames, even if they are black.
scale_notes.5: Something recognisable on screen: logos, video, menus.
scale_notes.6: The game world on screen and under player control.
scale_notes.7: In-game and under player control for 30+ minutes without a crash, at 20+ fps, on some PC.

projects.name: VIctory
projects.approach: Runs the console code natively on Windows; console GPU code recompiled to DXIL for D3D12.
projects.note: Boots, runs its menus at 30 fps and shows the first mission's title card. Inside the world the picture is dark at 1-2 fps. Reproduced on a second PC (RTX 4070 SUPER).
projects.blocker: The world: dark, 1-2 fps, and the GPU hangs after about 2 minutes. About 350 shader programs still untranslated.

milestones.text: Boots and runs its first-boot screens and menus at 30 fps
The first mission's title card renders; the world after it is dark
Same results reproduced on a second PC

projects.name: XCL
projects.approach: A general Xbox Series to Windows compatibility layer; also runs other console games fully.
projects.note: Starts in about 4 s, runs at a steady 30 fps without crashing, and gets through its menus to the settings.
projects.blocker: Gameplay not reached; the minimap's mesh pipelines are refused.

milestones.text: Menus and settings at a steady 30 fps
Unpacks the game's compressed streamed textures (BCPack)

projects.name: Leonida CE
projects.approach: Leonida community edition: static recompilation with experimental boot workarounds.
projects.note: With its workarounds the game creates every graphics pipeline, presents frames (still black, no window yet) and runs its audio. One run got past the usual crash and started loading the world (terrain and map data) for almost 6 minutes.
projects.blocker: A timing-dependent memory corruption (a race) usually crashes it at about 2 minutes; it was avoided only when the game ran slowed down under a debugger.

milestones.text: Presents its first frames (black, no window)
Runs to about 2 minutes; UI pipelines bound
Audio stop cleared: patched the game's audio lock leak, the audio thread runs
One run reaches world loading (terrain and map data) and runs for about 6 minutes

projects.name: Leonida Continued
projects.approach: The main continuation of the original Leonida (static recompilation, Vulkan).
projects.note: Has the original's full history and is merging back the boot fixes closed when the original went private. Now merged: the console graphics-device fixes for the early boot stops, frame pacing and presentation (PresentX), an XMA2 audio decoder and offline networking.
projects.blocker: No retail run on the merged code has been reported yet, so how far it now gets is unmeasured; the later stops still need the remaining fixes.

milestones.text: Original Leonida contributor builds reach the game's frame loop (stubbed pipelines)
Continuation fork opens; boot fixes start being re-merged
Boot fixes merged: console device stops, frame pacing/PresentX, XMA2 audio decoder, offline networking

projects.name: five-star-recomp
projects.approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox Series build.
projects.note: Gets through its first-run screens, loads story mode and reaches the story intro's title card. Stage self-reported; summarised from the project's README.
projects.blocker: Stops after the story intro's title card.

milestones.text: Loads story mode, then hangs on the first frame of the world
Reaches the story intro's title card, then stops

projects.name: Palmwave
projects.approach: A fork of XCL (Xbox Series compatibility layer for Windows).
projects.note: Loads the world and runs for up to an hour with sound. Stage self-reported; summarised from the GTA VI PC Race tracker.
projects.blocker: Shows nothing on screen while the world's compute shaders compile.

milestones.text: Loads the world and runs up to an hour with sound, no picture

projects.name: OpenScarlett CE
projects.approach: Community edition of OpenScarlett (Xbox Series translation layer).
projects.note: Plays the intro video with sound at 30 fps. Stage self-reported; summarised from the GTA VI PC Race tracker.
projects.blocker: Stops while the first scene streams in.

milestones.text: Intro video with sound at 30 fps

projects.name: OpenScarlett
projects.approach: Open-source C++20 Xbox Series translation layer.
projects.note: Startup passes and the intro video plays in full colour at 4K. Stage self-reported; summarised from the GTA VI PC Race tracker.
projects.blocker: Nothing reported past the intro video.

milestones.text: Intro video in full colour at 4K

projects.name: Xbox2Windows
projects.approach: Static recompilation research for Xbox Series software.
projects.note: Intro video and loading screen, but only with a modified diagnostic copy of the executable and a debugger skipping its asserts. Stage self-reported; summarised from the GTA VI PC Race tracker.
projects.blocker: Startup of the unmodified executable is unverified.

milestones.text: Intro video and loading (modified diagnostic copy)

projects.name: PercyScarlett
projects.approach: Xbox Series translation layer for Windows 10/11.
projects.note: Showed the game's setup screens (brightness screen). Stage self-reported; summarised from the GTA VI PC Race tracker.
projects.blocker: Screenshots and the game's name were withdrawn 20 minutes after posting.

milestones.text: Setup screens shown, then screenshots withdrawn

projects.name: GTA6-BootTest
projects.approach: Stand-in DLLs and a harness to boot the Xbox build.
projects.note: Shows the first interface screen through translated shaders. Stage self-reported; summarised from the GTA VI PC Race tracker.
projects.blocker: Nothing reported past the first screen.

milestones.text: First interface screen

projects.name: G6Recomp
projects.approach: Unofficial static recompilation of the Xbox Series build.
projects.note: Creates a window and the graphics device. Stage self-reported; summarised from the GTA VI PC Race tracker.

milestones.text: Window and graphics device

timeline.text: Take-Two files four DMCA notices on GitHub, all against GTA V ports. None names a GTA VI project.
The Xbox build's executable leaks, according to press reports; PC port projects start testing.
The original Leonida repo goes private and its creator steps away.
VIctory shows the first mission's title card; reproduced on a second PC.
Leonida CE presents its first (black) frames.
Leonida CE clears its audio stop; next stop is a double free at about 2 minutes.
five-star-recomp reaches the story intro's title card.
A Leonida CE run gets past its 2-minute crash and starts loading the world.
